definitions: The view that the existence of God, of the divine or the supernatural is unknown or unknowable.
A person who holds the view that any ultimate reality (such as God) is unknown and probably unknowable; a person who makes no claims about God's existence.
examples: His agnosticism was a result of his scientific upbringing.
She found comfort in agnosticism, not having to choose a side.
The debate touched upon the differences between atheism and agnosticism.
